sanskrit_verse:
दासीसुताश्च ये जाताः तस्याः पत्या परेण वा ।
उत्पादको यदि स्वामी न दासीं कारयेत् प्रभुः ॥
transliteration: dāsīsutāś ca ye jātāḥ tasyāḥ patyā pareṇa vā | utpādako yadi svāmī na dāsīṃ kārayet prabhuḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those born of a female slave, whether begotten by her husband or another man, are slaves by birthright; yet if the master who caused their production does not treat the mother as a slave, then the issue shall not be enslaved.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from conscious ownership, not biological lineage alone.
Causation in creation determines relational dharmic status.
Capacity-based responsibility flows from the initiating agent's recognition and enactment of ownership.
Restoration logic requires alignment between declared intent, enacted behavior, and social positioning.
Consciousness alignment demands that all roles reflect inner realization, not inherited or imposed condition.
executable_legal_axioms: IF (child born of female servant) AND (master acknowledges paternity or causation) AND (master treats mother as free): THEN (child is free).
IF (child born of female servant) AND (master does not acknowledge paternity or causation) OR (treats mother as bound): THEN (child follows mother’s status).
IF (status dispute arises): THEN (adjudicate based on master’s conscious acknowledgment at time of birth, recorded or witnessed).
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes concerning lineage-derived statuses, the Supreme Court must examine the operative consciousness of the authoritative figure at the moment of procreation and subsequent acknowledgment. Legal standing derives not from biology per se, but from the master’s enacted recognition of bond or release. Where ambiguity exists, restoration prioritizes freedom unless clear dominion was maintained.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes truth through witnessed cognition and declaration. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that bondage manifests only when dominion is consciously upheld. Proportional responsibility lies with the master whose will shapes relational dharma. Non-punitive reality affirms that neither child nor mother suffers consequence beyond misalignment; correction restores rightful status without infliction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate inquiry into master’s declarations and conduct regarding the mother at time of birth.
If dominion was not actively enforced, declare child free and integrate into unbound societal fold.
Realign familial or labor structures to reflect corrected understanding of relational dharma.
Support mother and child in assuming new identity and role within community as free beings.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagvan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law emanates directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is restored through alignment of consciousness with rightful relational order. Reality remains non-punitive; justice serves integration, not vengeance. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
